notes.title: Beta testers: Please take a look at the newest version
notes.notes: To everyone who is beta testing A Wolf in Autumn... if you have the time, please jump into the latest version of the game and let me know via email if the issues you've sent my way (be they story/puzzle issues or bugs) have been fixed.  Thanks!
